p22.author: Beyin A
p22.html: Good read! I totally agree, there isn’t enough representation in the tech industry in general, but yes, especially in more specialized roles like a PM one.

p22.author: Kayiita Johansson
p22.html: Agreed, this is endemic to the tech industry. There are a lot of sites, organizations and efforts to get more black people into technology – I wanted to ensure there was a site for black product managers as well!

p22.author: Kyra G
p22.html: Thank you for creating this site! I am a black woman who is considering product management and I am already inspired by your words.

p22.author: Kayiita Johansson
p22.html: So excited for you and I hope you join us!

p192.author: Beyin A
p192.html: Thanks for the explanation and the resources! PM seems like a pretty agile role though, not something that was obvious to me. Any advice on marketing yourself to meet this need in terms of diversity of skill set or learning ability?

p192.author: Kayiita Johansson
p192.html: Happy to share! Yes, there are many different ways PM roles instantiate themselves, including roles that prioritize Agile. The second article I link to shares a great POV on how that looks. RE: meeting the need for PM, I would recommend you check out the “How to become a PM” post here: https://pmwhileblack.com/2020/05/23/how-does-one-become-a-product-manager/

p235.author: Tobias
p235.html: I’d like to add to this by mentioning that reaching out to your devs, stakeholders, and other colleagues about light matter that aren’t always work related is a great way to build that rapport with them. You will need them to reprioritize their workload for you soon and they will only do it if they like you.

p235.author: Kayiita Johansson
p235.html: This is excellent advice! I could not agree more. Sooner or later, you’ll be knocking 🙂

p281.author: JP
p281.html: Thank you for sharing these resources! I’m in a professional transition and stumbled on your site. I’ve been in marketing for most of my career, but have an MBA, studied engineering in undergrad, and worked on a tech business for a couple of years. I’ve been trying to figure out my “it” professionally and I think PM may be in the running!

p281.author: Kayiita Johansson
p281.html: That is great to hear! If you are interested in mentorship and perhaps doing informational interviews, submit an application in the “Fam Forum” page and we will get back to you!

p281.author: Asmita
p281.html:
Hi Kayiita, thank you for sharing this. I’m not Black but I want to express how badly needed these forums are to uplift minority voices. As an immigrant woman of color who comes from a non-CS background, I’ve been finding it difficult to structure my PM learning journey, so this has been super helpful. I will implement the steps you suggested.

Thank you,
Asmita

p281.author: Chris G.
p281.html: This is really helpful! Thanks for laying out a full plan, end-to-end, for success. Excited to read more

p281.author: Kayiita Johansson
p281.html: So glad to hear that! Definitely submit a story in “success stories” if you get a PM role!
